## Each kind of delivery

167 `delivery/` folders in 6 SPACEs. A delivery's kind is the first that fits its files besides `deck/`, which every sNN has: a `.docx` is Word + PDF; a full `skill/` a skill; a full `ui/` a ui; a `.tex` LaTeX + PDF; then PDF, web page (`.html`), table (`.csv`, `.xlsx`), figure (`.png`, `.svg`), then a deck when it holds only slides, text; nothing at all is empty.
